name: claude-skills
tagline_zh: 写前端总在查 Tailwind 类名？部署 Cloudflare 反复试错？这个合集把常用全栈流程打包成技能。
tagline_en: Stop re-checking Tailwind classes or fumbling Cloudflare deploys. This pack turns common full-stack flows into.
desc_en: Skills for Claude Code CLI such as full stack dev Cloudflare, React, Tailwind v4, and AI integrations.
why_zh: 不是零散提示词，而是按真实项目节奏组织的技能集——从 React 组件到边缘部署，覆盖完整链路。
why_en: Not scattered prompts, but skills organized around real project flow—from React components to edge deployment—keeping Claude.
limit_zh: 仅适用于 Claude Code CLI 环境，且需手动安装每个技能。不含测试、数据库或认证方案。
limit_en: For Claude Code CLI only; manual install per skill. No testing, DB, or auth—just frontend & Cloudflare deploy. Outside that, you're on your own.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
